name: SplitView
description: Composed sidebar/content view backed by cu-splitter and cu-resizable-panel; optional collapse control.

accessibility.sidebar: inert when collapsed and excluded from keyboard focus
accessibility.toggle: native button with aria-expanded and aria-controls
accessibility.separator: reuses Splitter role=separator and aria-valuenow,min,max; Arrow keys and Home/End
accessibility.viewport: the host must have a usable height
accessibility.highContrast: focus and surfaces derive from tokens

notes: Content is consumer-owned and slotted, never interpolated as raw HTML.
